title: Scalar extension preserves a basis on one specified slice
statement: Use [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], slice restriction [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], section reconstruction [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence], and scalar tensor products [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. On the small pro-etale site of any scheme X, let R and S be commutative internal rings and a:R->S a ring map. If the section module reconstructed from an internal R-module L is isomorphic on the slice over W to the restricted R coefficient unit, then the section module reconstructed from the actual internal extension of scalars S tensor_R L is isomorphic on that same slice to the S coefficient unit. No flatness or hypothesis on L away from W is assumed; zero rings and empty slices are allowed.

source.place: clause (3), compatible finite bases, integral inverse limit, and rational scalar extension

proof.text: Section reconstruction gives an isomorphism between internal restriction of scalars and sectionwise restriction. Take its mate under the ordinary sheaf tensor/restriction adjunction and the internal extension/restriction adjunction. Both section-reconstruction functors are equivalences, so this mate is invertible. Its component at L identifies reconstructed internal extension with sheafification of the sectionwise balanced tensor product. No derived-category data is selected.

source.place: clause (3), compatible finite bases, integral inverse limit, and rational scalar extension

proof.text: Restriction to the slice has the same sections and covers at every object, so the independent-universe sheafification comparison is an isomorphism. Sectionwise tensoring the given basis identifies the restricted tensor presheaf with the S unit presheaf, by S tensor_R R -> S, s tensor r -> a(r)s, inverse s -> s tensor 1. Naturality follows from the basis naturality and ring-map naturality; balancing gives inverse equations. Sheafifying and using the sheafification counit finishes.

theorem spSliceScalarExtensionBasis (X : Scheme.{u})
    {R S : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}}
    [MonObj R] [IsCommMonObj R] [MonObj S] [IsCommMonObj S]
    (a : R ⟶ S) [IsMonHom a]
    (L : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) R)
    (W : X.ProEt)
    (e : (spRootBasisSliceSections X R W).obj L ≅
      (SheafOfModules.unit.{u, u + 1, u + 1} ((sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
          (sectionRingSheaf.{u + 1, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) R))).over W) :
    Nonempty ((spRootBasisSliceSections X S W).obj ((Mod.extendScalars a).obj L) ≅
      (SheafOfModules.unit.{u, u + 1, u + 1} ((sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
          (sectionRingSheaf.{u + 1, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) S))).over W)
